title: Streams container-policy feed snapshot (full, per cell)

kind.description: What the container holds, fixed at its creation: a streams container holds streams and a queues container queues. The cell refuses a policy that changes an accepted container's kind (edge #253).

requests_per_sec.description: Requests a second, one token each, with a burst of max(requests_per_sec, 50) (MULTITENANCY §17.3 r10). Also the rate of the project's store budget (one second's burst): a served request pays for the registry store work it made, a billed GET or HEAD 1 and a PUT, a listing or a COPY 10, and the project's creates, deletes, seals and catalog listings are refused while that budget is in debt (MULTITENANCY §17.3).

max_stored_bytes.description: Stored bytes the project may own: its live segments' stored page bytes after compression, page headers included (the unit of a stream's usage ownedStoredBytesNow). 0 or absent: the cell's CONTAINER_STORED_BYTES_DEFAULT, whose default 0 is no limit (MULTITENANCY §17.3, r9).

request_weight.description: The project's request weight on a cell shared k ways (CONTAINER_SHARE_K): its ceilings on requests_per_sec, max_inflight_requests, max_live_subscriptions and max_streams are the bound x weight / k. 0 or absent: weight 1, the equal share; the cell holds a weight to 1..k-1 (MULTITENANCY §17.3, layout 6A package 1). Ignored on a dedicated cell (k = 1).

byte_weight.description: The project's byte weight on a cell shared k ways: its ceilings on append_bytes_per_sec and read_bytes_per_sec are the bound x weight / k (queued_append_bytes stays at bound / k). 0 or absent: weight 1; held to 1..k-1. Ignored on a dedicated cell.
